# Ezekiel 29 — Disagreement Log

## 29:1 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-the-tenth year, in-the-tenth month, on-the-twelfth of-the-month, the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | On January 7, during the tenth year of King Jehoiachin's captivity, the LORD gave me this message: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

## 29:3 (overlap: 15%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Speak and-say: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Behold-Me against-you, Pharaoh king-of Egypt, the-great dragon who-lies in-the-midst-of his-rivers, who says, "My-Nile [is] mine and-I made-it for-myself."' |
| LOGOS | Speak, and say, Thus says the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his streams, that says, 'My Nile is my own; I made it for myself.' |
| PNEUMA | Give Pharaoh this message from the Sovereign LORD: I am your enemy, Pharaoh, king of Egypt — you great monster lying in your river! You said, 'The Nile is mine. I made it!' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
